description: This file defines an abstract base class 'issueTrackerInterface' in PHP, which serves as an interface for connecting and interacting with various issue tracking systems in a software project. It includes methods for configuration, connection management, issue retrieval, link generation, and status handling, meant to be extended by concrete subclasses implementing specific issue tracker APIs.

classes.name: issueTrackerInterface
classes.description: An abstract class providing a common interface for issue tracking systems, including configuration, connection, issue retrieval, and URL generation methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration and attempts to connect to the issue tracker based on provided settings.

methods.name: setCfg
methods.description: Sets and parses the XML configuration string for the issue tracker interface.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection to the issue tracking system if required.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the interface is currently connected to the issue tracker.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection if open.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntaxNumeric
methods.description: Validates if an issue ID is a valid numeric string.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntaxString
methods.description: Validates if an issue ID string does not contain forbidden characters.

methods.name: buildViewBugLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML link to view the specific issue, optionally including summary and reporter details.

methods.name: getEnterBugURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for entering a new issue in the tracker.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL to view a specific issue in the bug tracker.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Retrieves a human-readable status string of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummary
methods.description: Returns the summary of a given issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method meant to be implemented by subclasses to provide configuration templates.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks environment requirements for the issue tracker interface.

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Configures the resolved status mapping based on the configuration.

methods.name: getResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Retrieves the resolved status configuration.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the status string of an issue.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug ID exists in the issue tracker.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Creates a decorated HTML string representing the status.

methods.name: getBugSummaryMaxLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length for bug summaries.

methods.name: normalizeBugID
methods.description: Normalizes the bug ID string.
